<!DOCTYPE html>

<html class="h-full" lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>SkyFort Tactical Dashboard</title>
<!-- Tailwind CSS CDN -->
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<style data-purpose="custom-fonts-and-theme">
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap');
    
    body {
      font-family: 'Chakra+Petch', sans-serif;
      background-color: #0a0e14;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .mono-text {
      font-family: 'Share+Tech+Mono', monospace;
    }

    .glow-green {
      text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.5);
    }

    .border-tactical {
      border: 1px solid rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.5);
    }

    .bg-panel {
      background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    /* Custom scrollbar for the events log */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 4px;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: #0f172a;
    }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #334155;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="h-full flex flex-col p-2 gap-2">
<!-- BEGIN: MainHeader -->
<header class="flex items-center justify-between bg-panel border-tactical p-3 rounded-sm" data-purpose="top-navigation">
<div class="flex items-center gap-6">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<div class="w-8 h-8 bg-blue-600 rounded-sm flex items-center justify-center">
<svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5zM2 17l10 5 10-5M2 12l10 5 10-5"></path></svg>
</div>
<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold tracking-widest text-white uppercase italic">SkyFort</h1>
</div>
<div class="h-6 w-[1px] bg-slate-700"></div>
<div class="text-slate-400 font-semibold tracking-tighter">OUTPOST ALPHA</div>
<div class="bg-green-600/20 border border-green-500 text-green-400 px-6 py-0.5 rounded text-sm font-bold glow-green">
        ARMED
      </div>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-8">
<!-- Status Icons -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 text-slate-500">
<svg class="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M5 12l4-4m-4 4l4 4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"></path></svg>
<svg class="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"></path></svg>
<svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8.111 16.404a5.5 5.5 0 017.778 0M12 20h.01m-7.08-7.071a9.5 9.5 0 0114.142 0M6.25 6.25a15 15 0 0121.5 0" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"></path></svg>
</div>
<div class="mono-text text-lg flex items-center gap-4">
<span class="text-slate-200">14:35:28</span>
<span class="text-slate-400 text-sm">GPS: 31.922N, 35.013E</span>
</div>
</div>
</header>
<!-- END: MainHeader -->
<!-- BEGIN: MainContentArea -->
<main class="flex-grow grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 min-h-0">
<!-- Left Column: Tactical Map -->
<section class="col-span-4 flex flex-col bg-panel border-tactical relative overflow-hidden" data-purpose="tactical-map-panel">
<div class="absolute inset-0 z-0">
<img alt="Tactical Satellite Map" class="w-full h-full object-cover opacity-80" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
</div>
<!-- Map Overlays -->
<div class="absolute inset-0 z-10 pointer-events-none">
<!-- Target Marker T-014 -->
<div class="absolute top-[40%] left-[30%] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
<div class="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-red-500 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center relative">
<div class="w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></div>
<div class="absolute top-14 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-black/80 border border-red-500 text-red-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
              T-014 | 312m
            </div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Grid lines overlay -->
<div class="w-full h-full opacity-20" style="background-image: radial-gradient(circle, #334155 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 40px 40px;"></div>
</div>
<!-- Target Info Box (Bottom Left Overlay) -->
<div class="absolute bottom-4 left-4 z-20 w-48 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-700 p-3 text-[10px] mono-text uppercase tracking-wider">
<div class="text-slate-400 mb-2 border-b border-slate-700 pb-1">Target Info</div>
<div class="flex justify-between text-slate-200"><span>ID:</span> <span class="text-white">T-014</span></div>
<div class="flex justify-between text-slate-200"><span>Range:</span> <span class="text-white">312m</span></div>
<div class="flex justify-between text-slate-200"><span>Bearing:</span> <span class="text-white">128°</span></div>
<div class="flex justify-between text-slate-200"><span>Alt:</span> <span class="text-white">42m</span></div>
<div class="flex justify-between text-slate-200"><span>Class:</span> <span class="text-white">Small Quad</span></div>
<div class="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 text-green-500 font-bold">
<svg class="w-3 h-3" fill="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 20 20"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg>
          TRACKING GOOD
        </div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Center Column: Visual Feeds -->
<section class="col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-2" data-purpose="visual-feed-panel">
<!-- Drone Camera Feed -->
<div class="flex-grow bg-slate-900 border-tactical relative overflow-hidden">
<div class="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 bg-green-900/40 border border-green-500 text-green-400 px-3 py-1 font-bold text-sm glow-green">
          T-014 LOCKED
        </div>
<!-- Simulated Drone Feed -->
<div class="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 relative">
<!-- Central Crosshair -->
<div class="w-48 h-48 border border-green-500/30 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
<div class="w-4 h-[1px] bg-green-500 absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2"></div>
<div class="h-4 w-[1px] bg-green-500 absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"></div>
<!-- Drone Image Simulation -->
<div class="w-32 h-32 flex items-center justify-center">
<svg class="w-24 h-24 text-slate-200" fill="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 24 24">
<path d="M21 16.5c0 .38-.21.71-.53.88l-7.97 4.44a1.002 1.002 0 01-.98 0l-7.97-4.44A.988.988 0 013 16.5v-9c0-.38.21-.71.53-.88l7.97-4.44a1.002 1.002 0 01.98 0l7.97 4.44c.32.17.53.5.53.88v9z"></path>
</svg>
</div>
</div>
<div class="absolute bottom-4 mono-text text-green-400 text-sm tracking-widest">
            RANGE: 312m    ALT: 42m
          </div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Fall Zone Prediction -->
<div class="h-1/3 bg-panel border-tactical relative overflow-hidden">
<div class="absolute top-2 left-4 z-10 mono-text text-slate-400 text-xs tracking-tighter">PREDICTED FALL ZONE</div>
<!-- Mockup of parking lot fall zone -->
<div class="w-full h-full bg-slate-800 flex items-center justify-center grayscale contrast-125 brightness-75">
<div class="w-full h-full bg-[url('https://placehold.co/600x200/202020/404040?text=AERIAL+VIEW+PARKING')] bg-cover"></div>
<div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
<div class="w-24 h-24 border border-yellow-500/50 rounded-full bg-yellow-500/10 flex items-center justify-center">
<div class="bg-yellow-500 p-1 rounded-sm">
<svg class="w-4 h-4 text-black" fill="currentColor" viewbox="0 0 20 20"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8.257 3.099c.765-1.36 2.722-1.36 3.486 0l5.58 9.92c.75 1.334-.213 2.98-1.742 2.98H4.42c-1.53 0-2.493-1.646-1.743-2.98l5.58-9.92zM11 13a1 1 0 11-2 0 1 1 0 012 0zm-1-8a1 1 0 00-1 1v3a1 1 0 002 0V6a1 1 0 00-1-1z" fill-rule="evenodd"></path></svg>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="absolute bottom-2 right-4 text-[10px] text-yellow-500 font-bold tracking-widest bg-black/60 px-2 py-0.5 border border-yellow-500/50">
          MODERATE RISK: 1 PERSON DETECTED
        </div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Right Column: Combat Controls -->
<section class="col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-2" data-purpose="interceptors-panel">
<!-- Interceptor Status -->
<div class="flex-grow bg-panel border-tactical p-4 flex flex-col">
<h2 class="mono-text text-slate-400 text-sm tracking-widest mb-6 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">INTERCEPTORS</h2>
<div class="space-y-4">
<!-- Interceptor 1: Spent -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900/50 p-2 border border-slate-800 rounded">
<div class="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-600">1</div>
<div class="flex-grow">
<div class="flex justify-between items-end mb-1">
<span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-red-500">SPENT</span>
<span class="mono-text text-xs text-slate-400">357 KM/H</span>
</div>
<div class="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800">
<div class="w-0 h-full bg-red-600"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Interceptor 2: Ready -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900/50 p-2 border border-slate-800 rounded">
<div class="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-200">2</div>
<div class="flex-grow">
<div class="flex justify-between items-end mb-1">
<span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-green-500">READY</span>
<span class="mono-text text-xs text-slate-400">NOMINAL</span>
</div>
<div class="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800">
<div class="w-full h-full bg-green-500"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Interceptor 3: Ready -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 bg-slate-900/50 p-2 border border-slate-800 rounded">
<div class="text-3xl font-bold text-slate-200">3</div>
<div class="flex-grow">
<div class="flex justify-between items-end mb-1">
<span class="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-green-500">READY</span>
<span class="mono-text text-xs text-slate-400">NOMINAL</span>
</div>
<div class="w-full h-1 bg-slate-800">
<div class="w-full h-full bg-green-500"></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Action Button -->
<button class="h-24 bg-red-700 hover:bg-red-600 border-2 border-red-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(185,28,28,0.4)]" data-purpose="hold-fire-action">
<span class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-widest">HOLD FIRE</span>
<span class="text-[10px] text-red-200 font-bold mt-1">EMERGENCY MANUAL OVERRIDE</span>
</button>
</section>
</main>
<!-- END: MainContentArea -->
<!-- BEGIN: BottomPanel -->
<footer class="h-40 bg-panel border-tactical p-4 flex flex-col gap-3" data-purpose="event-log-panel">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
<div class="flex items-center gap-6">
<h3 class="mono-text text-sm font-bold tracking-widest text-slate-300">EVENTS LOG</h3>
<div class="flex gap-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
<button class="text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></span> All</button>
<button class="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-600"></span> Warnings</button>
<button class="text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1"><span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-800"></span> Critical</button>
</div>
</div>
<button class="text-[10px] border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors uppercase font-bold tracking-widest">Export Log</button>
</div>
<div class="overflow-y-auto flex-grow mono-text text-sm space-y-1">
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 py-0.5 border-b border-slate-900/50">
<span class="text-slate-500 w-16">14:34:22</span>
<span class="text-green-500 font-bold w-40">TRACKING LOCKED</span>
<span class="text-slate-300">TARGET DESIGNATION T-014 SECURED AT 312M</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 py-0.5 border-b border-slate-900/50">
<span class="text-slate-500 w-16">14:32:05</span>
<span class="text-yellow-500 font-bold w-40">TARGET DETECTED</span>
<span class="text-slate-300">ANOMALY DETECTED IN SECTOR 4-B. SCANNING...</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 py-0.5 border-b border-slate-900/50">
<span class="text-slate-500 w-16">14:30:00</span>
<span class="text-blue-500 font-bold w-40">SYSTEM ARMED</span>
<span class="text-slate-300">ALL DEFENSE GRIDS ACTIVE. INTERCEPTORS ON STANDBY.</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-4 py-0.5">
<span class="text-slate-500 w-16">14:27:12</span>
<span class="text-slate-500 font-bold w-40">DIAGNOSTIC</span>
<span class="text-slate-500">CALIBRATING OPTICAL SENSORS... OK</span>
</div>
</div>
</footer>
<!-- END: BottomPanel -->
</body></html>
